import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;

    static class Edge {
        int v, r;
        long f, c, p;
        Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
            this.v = v; this.r = r; this.f = f; this.c = c; this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 50 * T + 2;
        List<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[N];
        int[] sz = new int[N];
        long mc;

        Flow() {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void init(int n) {
            mc = 0;
            Arrays.fill(sz, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
            adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
        }

        boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
        int[] par = new int[N];
        long[] pot = new long[N];
        long[] dist = new long[N];

        void pot_init(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.c != 0) {
                            pot[e.v] = Math.min(pot[e.v], pot[u] + e.p);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long mcf(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0, n, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            if (sparse) {
                Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.offer(s);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = q.poll();
                    if (vis[u]) continue;
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                            q.offer(e.v);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int u = s;
                while (u != -1) {
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                        }
                    }
                    u = -1;
                    long best = INF;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[i];
                            u = i;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] >= INF) return 0;
            long df = INF;
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[par[u]].get(adj[par[u]].get(0).r).v) {
                Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
                df = Math.min(df, e.c - e.f);
            }
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[par[u]].get(adj[par[u]].get(0).r).v) {
                Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
                e.f += df;
                adj[r.v].get(r.r).f -= df;
                price[0] += df * e.p;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            return df;
        }

        long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            pot_init(n);
            long flow = 0;
            long[] df = new long[1];
            while ((df[0] = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse)) != 0) {
                flow += df[0];
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        Flow flow = new Flow();
        flow.init(sink + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            flow.add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    flow.add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    flow.add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    flow.add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow_value = flow.min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        if (flow_value != k) {
            throw new AssertionError("Flow does not match k");
        }
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
